name: Naitou Maia
source:
The worst trauma that appears in [url=/c11601]Tooru’s[/url] dreams. 

She’s the one behind him getting trapped in dreams. 

But as long as he had lucid dreams, she wasn’t supposed to appear ever again.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616215827/https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1064]Mangagamer[/url]]
